typical_symptoms: multiple bruises at varying stages of healing

red_flags: strangulation history (petechiae, odynophagia, hoarseness - high risk of delayed carotid injury/homicide)

Full forensic body map & photographic documentation
Soft tissue neck imaging if strangulation reported
HIV/STI Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) if sexual assault

condition: Obstetric Emergency: Postpartum Hemorrhage & Severe Pre-eclampsia
risk_factors: uterine atony (4Ts: Tone, Tissue, Trauma, Thrombin)
prior history of pre-eclampsia / chronic hypertension
low-resource delivery setting without skilled birth attendance
red_flags: systolic BP >= 160 mmHg or diastolic BP >= 110 mmHg (Hypertensive Crisis in Pregnancy)
HELLP syndrome (Hemolysis, Elevated Liver enzymes, Low Platelets)
recommended_tests: Intravenous Magnesium Sulfate for eclampsia seizure prophylaxis
Urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio (UPCR) and CBC/coagulation/liver panel
authoritative_source: WHO Recommendations on Maternal Mortality Reduction & PPH (2025) / MMEIG / Lancet 2025

condition: Neonatal Preterm Birth Complications & Respiratory Distress
typical_symptoms: low birth weight (<2500g) or very low (<1500g)
duration: Immediate perinatal period (< 28 days of life)
risk_factors: maternal untreated infections (malaria, bacterial vaginosis, UTI)
red_flags: central cyanosis / oxygen saturation < 88% on room air
necrotizing enterocolitis (abdominal distension, bilious aspirates, bloody stool)
recommended_tests: Continuous Pulse Oximetry and Temperature monitoring
Chest Radiograph (reticulogranular 'ground glass' pattern with air bronchograms)
Bedside blood gas analysis (pH, pCO2, lactate)
authoritative_source: WHO Guidelines on Care of Preterm or Low-Birth-Weight Infant (Born Too Soon 2023) / Lancet 2023

condition: Congenital Anomalies (Congenital Heart Defects / Neural Tube Defects)
typical_symptoms: central cyanosis unresponsive to 100% oxygen (hyperoxia test)
pathological heart murmur with poor feeding and sweating during feeds
visible structural midline defects (cleft lip/palate, spina bifida cystica)
risk_factors: maternal periconceptional folate deficiency (neural tube defects)
maternal teratogenic exposures (valproic acid, isotretinoin, alcohol)
red_flags: ductal-dependent critical congenital heart disease (rapid circulatory collapse upon ductus arteriosus closure)
spina bifida with leaking CSF (meningitis risk)
congenital diaphragmatic hernia with severe pulmonary hypoplasia
differential_diagnoses: Critical Congenital Heart Disease (Tetralogy of Fallot, TGA, Coarctation)
recommended_tests: Universal Newborn Pulse Oximetry Screening (hands and feet)
authoritative_source: WHO Fact Sheet on Birth Defects 2023 / GBD 2021 / American Heart Association (AHA)

typical_symptoms: severe somatic muscle wasting and loss of subcutaneous fat ('old man facies' - Marasmus)
bilateral pitting pedal edema migrating to ascites and anasarca (Kwashiorkor)
duration: Weeks to months of chronic caloric and protein deprivation
risk_factors: children under 5 years in food-insecure regions
early cessation of breastfeeding without safe complementary food
red_flags: severe dehydration without diarrhea due to low intravascular volume (fluid overload risk with IV fluids!)
recommended_tests: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC < 115 mm defines SAM)
Serum Electrolytes (watch for refeeding syndrome: hypophosphatemia, hypokalemia)
authoritative_source: WHO Guidelines on the Management of Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) / Nutrients 2022 / GBD 2023

typical_symptoms: visible enlargement of anterior neck / thyroid gland (goiter)
cold intolerance, weight gain, fatigue, dry skin (hypothyroidism)
impaired intellectual development, cognitive slowing and developmental delay in children
duration: Chronic nutritional deficiency over months to years
risk_factors: inland/mountainous soil zones depleted of iodine
pregnant and lactating women (increased thyroid hormone demand)
consumption of goitrogenic foods (cassava, millet) without adequate iodine
red_flags: congenital iodine deficiency syndrome (cretinism: severe irreversible cognitive disability, deaf-mutism, dwarfism)
large compressive goiter causing stridor, dysphagia, or tracheal deviation
myxedema coma in severe untreated hypothyroidism
recommended_tests: Median Urinary Iodine Concentration (UIC < 100 ug/L indicates population deficiency; <20 ug/L severe)
Serum Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) and Free T4
Thyroid Ultrasound for nodularity and volume
Thyroperoxidase (anti-TPO) antibodies to rule out Hashimoto's
authoritative_source: Iodine Global Network (IGN Scorecard 2024) / WHO Nutrition Guidelines / GBD 2021

typical_symptoms: night blindness (nyctalopia - difficulty seeing in dim light / early sign)
Bitot's spots (foamy, silver-gray triangular plaques on bulbar conjunctiva)
increased susceptibility to recurrent diarrhea and measles
duration: Insidious progression over weeks to months as hepatic retinol stores deplete
risk_factors: preschool children aged 6-59 months in low SDI regions
diet lacking preformed vitamin A (animal liver, dairy) and provitamin A carotenoids (orange vegetables)
red_flags: corneal ulceration and keratomalacia (rapid liquefactive necrosis of cornea leading to irreversible corneal rupture and blindness within 24-48 hours)
measles infection in a vitamin A-deficient child (very high fatality rate)
recommended_tests: Serum Retinol / Retinol-Binding Protein level (< 0.70 umol/L defines deficiency; < 0.35 umol/L severe)
Slit-lamp Biomicroscopic eye examination with Fluorescein staining
Clinical grading according to WHO Xerophthalmia classification
authoritative_source: WHO Guidelines on Vitamin A Supplementation / UNICEF 2023 / GBD 2021
